title: The Cowboy Who Couldn't Catch His Hat
narration: One desert gust stole Jesse's hat. He sprinted down Main Street, caught the brim, and spun right back in a cloud of dust.

beats.action: Jesse smirks comfortably as the first desert wind ripple begins tugging at his hat brim
Jesse gasps with wide shocked eyes as his hat rockets away into Main Street
Jesse grit-teeth sprints down Main Street chasing the tumbling hat past the hitching post
Jesse snatches the hat brim cleanly at chest height, then a reverse gust rips it flipping overhead
Hat thuds crooked onto Jesse's brow; he settles arms limp with deadpan side-eye as dust drifts away
